risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Exposure to interest rate fluctuations affecting the value of investments and guaranteed annuity reserves ($6.4 billion in reserves).

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Exposure to counterparties and bond issuers that may fail to meet their obligations.

risks.title: Real Estate Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: Significant dependence on residential and commercial real estate activity, affected by interest rates, unemployment rates, and housing prices.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: Ability to meet short- and long-term liquidity needs with exposure to policy withdrawals.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: Limited risk due to minimal exposure to foreign currencies, with the majority of revenue generated in the United States.

risks.title: Counterparty Risk
risks.score_rationale: Exposure to counterparties in reinsurance agreements and investments that may fail to meet their obligations.

risks.title: Market Volatility Risk
risks.score_rationale: Exposure to volatility in equity and bond prices within the investment portfolio ($493 million in traded equities).
